notes.title: Update announcement on February 2
notes.notes:
On Monday, January 30, S271-S282 will clean up inactive accounts irregularly, each time lasting 10-20 minutes. Inactive accounts refer to: 1. Not occupying land above level 10. 2. Not online for three consecutive days. 3. No recharging has been performed. If the above three points are met at the same time, the account is inactive and will be cleared.

The full service will be maintained from 10:00 to 14:00 on Thursday, February 2. After the maintenance, the "Happy New Year" activity will end and the new activity "Warm Spring" will be officially launched. S271-S279 enters the third season and S280-S282 enters the second season. Please refer to the season description in the general trend of the world for the specific contents of the season. Attention of the relevant masters of this season's settlement: the roulette award of the last activity will be distributed to your mailbox at 0:00 on February 2. If you don't go to the mailbox before the maintenance on February 2, the season settlement will empty the mailbox. Please try to get rewards before maintenance. Please pay more attention to the progress and recruitment times of the new season's wish cards and Nirvana cards.

After the maintenance on February 2, this issue of the pub Nirvana card pack powerful magic generals: Melubu, Magic Zhou Cang, who have not been drawn before, can go to draw.

After the maintenance on February 2, the "Spring Festival activity" ended, and the experience of field brushing was doubled, and the field 18-20 Yellow Scarf Army returned to normal. Wish that the pool devil of the card pack will remove the "Melubi".

The new service S287 will be opened at 10 a.m. on Saturday, February 4.

The activities of "Warm Spring and Blossoming Flowers" are as follows:

The activity time is from 10:00 on February 2 to 23:59 on February 15.

Activity 1: Golden Egg Gift

During the activity, golden eggs and silver eggs appear from time to time. You can get a great reward after defeating the golden or silver eggs.

Activity 2: Lucky Wheel

During the event, you can get 3 turntable raffle tickets by logging in every day. You can transfer to orange and even divine pieces on the lucky turntable. The pieces of Shenjiang that can be turned on this lucky turntable are: pieces of Shenlu Zhi, pieces of Shentai Shici and pieces of Shencao Ren.

★★★★★★★ The new out-of-print magic general - Magic Zhao Yu

Devil Zhao woman positioning: kitchen knife output core auxiliary. Branch: cavalry

The first skill: the will of the Virgin: active: the probability of casting is 50%, which immediately causes a large amount of attack damage to the enemy's three people, and increases the attack, hit and rage of the enemy's three people, lasting for 2 rounds.

The second skill: Elephant Leg Hurricane: Command: Triggered in the third round, it will make three enemies fall into a dizzy state for one round, and reduce the attack, defense and dodge of the target, and obtain the bleeding effect, lasting for three rounds.

Detachable skill: Gathering of heroes: command: trigger in the first round, make yourself obtain the fearless effect (reduce the total damage received) and the uplifting effect (increase the total damage), and increase the critical hit for 2 rounds (increase the skill level can increase the number of continuous rounds, and the highest level can last for 5 rounds).

Evaluation:

Comprehensive evaluation: As an assistant, Magic Zhao Yu can add attack, hit, rage and other attributes to all friends, which perfectly matches the kitchen knife generals. With the command skill triggered in the third round, you can better counter attack the enemy. Vertigo all the enemy for one round, reduce all the enemy's attack, defense and dodge at the same time, and let the enemy's generals fall into a state of bloodshed. After one move, two moves, the situation can form a major reversal. As a kind of post-emptive assistance, friendly generals can effectively combat and relieve pressure. The disassembling skill "gathering of heroes" is the best magic skill of the kitchen knife generals, which can greatly increase the output limit of the kitchen knife generals. It is strongly recommended that you make one. Recommended lineup: Devil Lv Bu+Devil Sun Zan+Devil Zhao Nu (the strength of the official army is needless to say), Devil Zhao Nu+Divine Wenchou+Divine Lv Bu.

Activity 3: New holiday bar card package

The powerful magic will "Devil Zhao Woman" enter the card bag of this festival pub. The three generals, God Lu Zhi, God Tai Shi Ci and God Cao Ren, appear again in the card bag of the pub after half a year. Don't miss what you want, and you can draw freely.

Activity 4: Redeem rewards

During the activity, every battle in the wild has the chance to drop the words: spring, warm, flower, open. Collect these words and you can exchange them for the treasure chest, the treasure chest of the famous general, the raffle ticket, the treasure chest of the universal celebration, the treasure chest of the local celebration, and the fragment box of the magic general.

Activity 5: Recharge rewards

If the accumulated recharge during the event reaches a certain amount, you will get a lot of rewards. This award is mainly based on the out-of-print god general "Shenmadai". Principals who have not drawn Shenmadai in the previous activities or have not enough pieces of Shenmadai can get it in the recharge reward.

In addition, the 5000, 10000, and 20000 levels of this accumulative recharge activity have added several enhanced Bichengdan.

The 20000 level has also added the special skill to disassemble the military general "Xushi Liji Fragment", which can disassemble the new three skills, which can not be missed.

Recharge rewards are more abundant.

Activity 6: Login rewards

During the event, you can get 50 yuan, 50 noble points, 5 worship posts, 2 intermediate technology accelerations, 2 intermediate construction accelerations and 3 raffle tickets by logging in every day.

Activity 7: Recharge and double return

During the event, the setting that the first purchase in the recharging interface can obtain double treasure will be reset, and players who have already purchased can enjoy double treasure treatment again.

Activity 8: Reset the single recharging activity. The magic treasure chest in the single recharging reward in this period is "magic treasure chest of Shu".

Activity 9: Reset of continuous recharge activity

Activity 10: The opening of a new cumulative consumption activity

The activity time is from 10:00 on February 2 to 23:59 on February 15. The god in the reward changed the fragment into the fragment of God's literary engagement.

Activity 11: Opening of a new period of premium discount activity

The discount props in this issue are: the shards of Zhao Yun, the one-day activation props of the nobility, the intermediate technology acceleration, the three-star material package of cavalry, the forest pavilion, the medium physical potion, the intermediate recruitment order, and the merit.

Activity 12: The Shenjiang fragments of Meritorious Mall, Honor Mall and Hufu Mall are updated

The Meritorious Mall was updated to: God Cao Pi, God Zhao Yun

The Honor Mall was updated to: Shen Lvbu, Shen Diao Chan

Hufu Mall is updated to: God Zuo Ci, God Guo Jia

Activity 13: Adjust the content of the gift package purchased by recharging.

The fragments of military generals in the resource gift package from Monday to Saturday turned into fragments of Shentai Shici.



The new version of the system is under production. Please look forward to it.
